title: Chiang Mai Sunday Night Market Tasting
description: Wander the immense Sunday Walking Street in Chiang Mai alongside a local culinary expert, decoding the rich, complex flavors of Northern Thai (Lanna).
content:
> **Executive Summary:**
>
> *   The "Chiang Mai Sunday Night Market Tasting" is a 3-hour evening culinary experience focusing on Northern Thai (Lanna) cuisine, specifically Khao Soi, Sai Oua, and Nam Prik Num, starting at Tha Phae Gate. This experience involves moderate physical demand due to walking through dense crowds.
> *   This year-round offering, best paired with a weekend evening in Chiang Mai, includes luxury SUV transfers and requires advance booking. Asia Golf Specialists provides priority reservations and skip-the-line access.
> *   After a day on the fairways of Alpine Golf Resort Chiang Mai or Highlands Golf and Spa Resort, this private guided food tour provides the ultimate cultural immersion without the logistical hassle of navigating the crowds alone.
>
> *Related: Explore our [Premium Southeast Asia Tours](/tours/) luxury itinerary.*

## The AGS Executive Summary
Wander the immense Sunday Walking Street in Chiang Mai alongside a local culinary expert, decoding the rich, complex flavors of Northern Thai (Lanna) cuisine.

![Chiang Mai Sunday Night Market Walking Street cultural food tour Thailand](/images/destinations/thailand/culinary/thailand-culinary-market-stalls.webp)

## The Operator & Origin Story
Northern Thai food is distinct—it lacks the coconut milk sweetness of the south and relies heavily on complex, earthy spice pastes, bitter herbs, and sticky rice. The Sunday market is the ultimate showcase of this regional identity.

While the markets in Bangkok might feel like a sprawling labyrinth of international goods, the Chiang Mai Sunday Night Market retains a distinctly local flavor. It acts as a weekly gathering for artisans, hill tribes, and local chefs bringing generation-old recipes to the streets of the old city.

## What to Expect
This isn't your standard point-and-eat street food experience. Our hand-picked culinary guides have intimate relationships with the vendors—some of whom have been perfecting a single dish for decades.

You will skip the generic pad thai stands and dive straight into the heritage dishes of the Lanna kingdom. The evening balances walking through the vibrant, bustling arteries of the market with quiet moments in hidden courtyards where you can sit and savor the complex flavors.

![Khao Soi Curry Noodle Soup Chiang Mai Northern Thai Cuisine](/images/destinations/thailand/culinary/thailand-michelin-star-traditional-dining.webp)

## The Itinerary & Deep Dive
Meet your guide at the Tha Phae Gate as the sun sets. As you enter the walled city, your guide directs you past the standard tourist souvenirs straight to the heritage food stalls. 

You will taste Khao Soi (curry noodle soup), Sai Oua (spicy herbaceous sausage), and Nam Prik Num (roasted green chili dip). The experience is a masterclass in regional flavor profiles.

*   **Khao Soi** — A rich, coconut curry noodle soup that is the crown jewel of Chiang Mai. We visit a vendor who grinds their curry paste by hand daily.
*   **Sai Oua** — This Northern Thai sausage is packed with lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, and galangal.
*   **Nam Prik Num** — A fiery, smoky dip made from roasted green chilies, usually enjoyed with crispy pork rinds and sticky rice.

![Sai Oua Northern Thai Sausage Chiang Mai Sunday Market](/images/destinations/thailand/culinary/thailand-culinary-bangkok-terrace-dining-large.webp)

![Anantara Chiang Mai Resort Luxury Accommodation Thailand](/images/destinations/thailand/accommodations/thailand-four-seasons-chiang-mai.webp)

## Insider Tips for Golfers
Navigating the Sunday Market after a 4-hour round of golf requires strategy. Here are a few insider tips from our local team:

1\. **Hydrate Pre-Market:** The crowds can be dense and the evening air humid. Hydrate well after your round at Alpine Golf Resort.
2\. **Footwear:** Swap the golf shoes for comfortable, closed-toe walking shoes. The market covers a massive area.
3\. **Pacing:** Don't eat at the first stall you see. Your guide has a curated route that builds in flavor intensity.
4\. **Private Transfer:** The traffic around the old city on Sunday evenings is notoriously gridlocked. Your AGS luxury SUV transfer ensures a seamless drop-off and pick-up, completely bypassing the Tuk-Tuk haggling.

![Luxury SUV Transfer Chiang Mai Asia Golf Specialists](/images/destinations/thailand/culture/thailand-midnight-tuktuk-food-tour.webp)

faqs.q: How do we schedule the Chiang Mai Sunday Night Market tour around golf at Chiang Mai Highlands and Alpine?
faqs.a: Play a morning round at Chiang Mai Highlands Golf & Spa Resort, Alpine Golf Resort Chiang Mai, or Mae Jo Golf Resort (finishing by 12:30 PM), rest at Four Seasons Resort Chiang Mai or Tamarind Village, and meet your guide at Tha Phae Gate at 5:30 PM.

faqs.q: What if our Chiang Mai golf itinerary doesn't fall on a Sunday night?
faqs.a: If your Northern Thailand golf dates fall mid-week, Asia Golf Specialists pivots your private culinary walk to the Saturday Wua Lai Walking Street Market, the nightly Chang Phuak (North Gate) food stalls, and the Warorot riverside market.

faqs.q: What Northern Thai (Lanna) specialties do golfers taste on the Chiang Mai night market walk?
faqs.a: Your culinary host curates smoky Sai Oua (herb-packed Northern pork sausage), Khao Soi coconut curry noodles, Nam Prik Noom roasted green chili dip with crispy pork rinds, and hot coconut-cream Khanom Krok pancakes.
